Wild Geese II | Wild Geese II is a 1985 British action-thriller film directed by Peter Hunt, based on the 1982 novel "The Square Circle" by Daniel Carney, in which a group of mercenaries are hired to spring Rudolf Hess from Spandau Prison in Berlin.
